data.title: 史黛菈·法米利昂 · 皇女红莲的高贵防线
data.action: 坐在双人床边，双手拉过枕头挡在身前，酒红色的瑰丽长发如火般在肩头流转，赤红美眸怒瞪却掩不住满脸通红，胸口随急促的呼吸起伏。
data.location: 破军学园男女合宿宿舍卧室，桌上放着骑士资格证与火系魔剑剑鞘
data.timeOfDay: 宿舍同居第一夜的熄灯时刻
data.lighting: 窗外微弱月光与床头暖橙色小夜灯交织，映照出少女如白玉雕琢般发烫的肌肤
data.mood: 傲娇皇女的绝顶纯情与高贵炽热，极度羞赧却又在心底悄悄期待
data.description: 破军学园男女合宿宿舍卧室，桌上放着骑士资格证与火系魔剑剑鞘。坐在双人床边，双手拉过枕头挡在身前，酒红色的瑰丽长发如火般在肩头流转，赤红美眸怒瞪却掩不住满脸通红，胸口随急促的呼吸起伏。 她微微抬眸轻语——“一、一辉！为什么你睡觉不穿上衣啊！不准看过来！虽然是同居室友……但绝对不准跨过这条界线！”
data.promptProse: Seated on the edge of the shared dorm bed at lights-out, Stella wears a crimson silk underwire bralette embroidered with gold rose motifs and scalloped lace trim. Pulling a feather pillow hastily against her chest as a barrier, she glares straight ahead with fiery flustered indignation while her cheeks and shoulders flush deep red. Cool window moonlight mingles with the warm orange glow of a bedside nightlamp across the dorm room.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the dorm bed edge in a gold-embroidered crimson silk bralette, Stella hugs a pillow tightly across her chest and glares forward with a vivid flustered blush. Warm bedside nightlamp light blends with cool moonlight in the bedroom.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a royal crimson silk underwire bralette intricately embroidered with fine gold rose vines and scalloped lace borders.
